description: Step 5b — bulk-approve N clusters in one call. Recommended path when an agent wants to move multiple clusters forward. Approving a cluster fires an async seo_brief_generate Operation per cluster; brief generation only runs on approved clusters. Typically takes ~2–5 min per cluster. Response includes `operations: [{ clusterId, operationId }]` and `operationIds: string[]` — Poll `get_job` with the operationId until `state` is `completed` (or `failed`/`partially_failed`/`cancelled` on error).

clusterIds.description: Cluster IDs from seo_list_clusters to approve

name: seo_bulk_approve_clusters
